chunks: And he, peace be upon him, said:
Exchange gifts with one another, and you will love one another.

key_terms.السَّلَامُ: peace; part of the honorific meaning peace be upon him
key_terms.تَحَابُّوا: you will come to love one another
key_terms.عَلَيْهِ: upon him; part of the honorific for the Imam

ai.seo_question: How does exchanging gifts help build love between people in hadith teachings?
ai.summary: The Imam عليه السلام teaches that giving gifts strengthens affection between people. The hadith highlights gift-giving as a simple ethical practice that nurtures love and social harmony.
